D3 a second device signed in as the same customer sees the same cart
D4 two devices: the first changes the quantity; the second, still on the old version, is refused (409 cart_version_conflict), is told so and shows the backend's cart again
D5 SIGN-OUT: the browser shows an empty cart and holds a NEW guest token; the signed-out session token reads no cart; the account's cart stays on the server for the account
D5b after sign-out the cart is read as a guest: no cart request carries the old session token

E2 what the cart keeps of the journey is labels and figures only: no coordinate, no address, no route geometry — in the API answer and in the database row

results.name: E4 the journey ENDS (expired): the cart stays, can still proceed, and marks the route figures as stale — "This journey has ended. Plan it again…" — instead of showing an old detour as current
E5 a cart started by browsing a restaurant directly has no journey and works the same
E6 somebody else's journey cannot be linked: 404 journey_not_found
F1 GUEST IDOR: another guest who knows the cart id and a line id gets nowhere (404, 404, 404, an empty cart); a token in the URL is ignored
F2 a tampered or made-up token is nobody's: no cart, a fresh token
F3 CUSTOMER IDOR: Asha cannot change or remove a line of Rahul's cart and Rahul cannot touch Asha's (404 each); both carts are unchanged
F4 a signed-in customer is the customer: a guest token sent along does not switch them to that guest's cart

F5 RESTAURANT STAFF AND ADMINISTRATORS HAVE NO ACCESS TO CARTS: the restaurant owner sees no cart and cannot change one; there is no cart listing for staff or administrators (404); a staff token cannot claim a cart (401)
G1 TWO SIMULTANEOUS FIRST ADDS on two API processes for the same new guest: one cart, one line, quantity 2 — never two carts or two lines
G2 two devices change the quantity from the same version at the same moment (two processes): exactly one wins, the other gets 409 cart_version_conflict, and the cart holds the winner's value

G3 A DOUBLE TAP / RETRY with the same Idempotency-Key (in parallel on two processes, then once more): applied once — the quantity rose by 2, not by 4 or 6; the repeat is answered with the first answer (Idempotency-Replayed) or told the first is still running
G4 the same key with a different request is refused (409 idempotency_key_reused), not guessed at
H1 an EXPIRED cart says so on the page and in the API (status EXPIRED, CART_EXPIRED), still shows what was in it, and refuses every change with 410 cart_expired
H2 "Start a new cart" clears it (the only way out); the next item starts a new cart for the same guest
H3 the cleanup (php artisan carts:prune, scheduled hourly): a cart past its lifetime and the 24-hour grace is closed as EXPIRED; a cart closed more than 30 days ago is deleted with its lines
results.detail: Closed 1 expired cart(s); deleted 1 closed cart(s) past retention.
